name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or feature enhancement for PitchRoast
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: I'm always frustrated when [...]

### ✨ Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Consider the multi-agent committee, 3D presentation deck, Phoenix tracing, or Founder Hotseat mode.

### 🎨 Visuals or Mockups
If applicable, add screenshots, ASCII diagrams, or mockups to help explain your idea.

### 🔄 Alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 🧑‍💻 Are you willing to submit a PR?
- [ ] Yes, I'd love to implement this!
- [ ] I can help test or review
- [ ] No, just sharing the idea

### 📌 Additional context
Add any other context, model provider considerations (`claude-3-5-sonnet`, `claude-3-opus`, `claude-3-5-haiku`, etc.), or links.
